name: openpen
description: Let Claude draw annotations on your screen and take screenshots through OpenPen.
long_description: Connects Claude Desktop to the OpenPen app running on this computer. Turn on the MCP server in OpenPen Settings > MCP, copy the API key shown there, and paste it here. If you changed the port in OpenPen, enter the same port here. Only OpenPen on this computer is reached; nothing is sent over the network.

api_key.title: OpenPen API key
api_key.description: Copy it from OpenPen Settings > MCP after turning on the MCP server.

port.title: OpenPen port
port.description: Leave 17639 unless you changed the port in OpenPen Settings > MCP; then enter the same number.
